verdict.rationale: ROS 2 has no OpenAPI spec. Its typed interfaces (topics, services and actions, e.g. std_msgs/msg/String) do act as an IDL-like equivalent, and one community comment likens ROS message definitions to shared .proto/.thrift files. The evidence never documents these definitions as a downloadable, machine-readable spec of the system's API. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the interface definition format (.msg/.srv/.action) as a machine-readable spec, a downloadable or exportable API spec artifact, and any OpenAPI/AsyncAPI-style export for agent tooling.
